atoms.text: Alexa is preparing for her exams. She made herself a schedule, so she can organise herself better

instruction.text: Answer the following questions about Alexa’s schedule.

atoms.a: In how many time slots has Alexa scheduled chatting as a possible activity?
How many hours has Alexa scheduled for studying?
How many hours could Alexa spend doing some form of exercise?
atoms.sound: ssml: How many hours <break time='100ms'/>could,<break time='100ms'/> Alexa spend doing some form of exercise?

atoms.a: If Alexa follows her schedule perfectly for five days, how much studying will she do?
How much time per day will Alexa spend having breakfast and lunch?
If Alexa studied instead of having outdoor time, how much time will Alexa study for in a day?
Alexa decided to do all her planning during breakfast instead of throughout the day. In how many time slots could she now do something else?
Alexa felt tired one day, so she watched TV instead of organising, listening to music and having outdoor time. How many hours did she spend watching TV in total?
